# SD-24 Epic 5 (criterion 5.1) deterministic Human Fighter 9 / Wizard 1
# multiclass level-10 fixture (Fighter-dominant split).
#
# Represents a character that advanced levels 1-9 as a solo Fighter, then
# took its first Wizard level at total character level 10 (Fighter 9 /
# Wizard 1) -- the Fighter-side half of criterion 5.1's "advancement from
# level 1 -> 10 succeeds" acceptance text. It names selections only; it does
# not contain derived, computed, or parity values.
#
# Built by combining the already-accepted deterministic Fighter feat/choice
# posture (`pf1_human_fighter_level9_sd13_deterministic_input.txt`'s own
# level-1/2/4/6/8 bonus-feat selections and both weapon-training-group
# selections) with the already-accepted deterministic Wizard
# school-specialization posture
# (`pf1_human_wizard_level1_sd13_deterministic_input.txt`'s own canonical
# Evocation-specialist / Necromancy-and-Transmutation-opposed selections),
# under a single consistent ability-score array (the Fighter fixture's own
# scores, since Fighter is the majority class here) rather than re-deriving
# either posture.
case_id=pf1-crb-human-fighter9-wizard1-sd24-multiclass-lv10
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:human
class_level=class:fighter:9
class_level=class:wizard:1
ability=strength:16
ability=dexterity:14
ability=constitution:14
ability=intelligence:13
ability=wisdom:12
ability=charisma:8
feat=feat:power_attack
feat=feat:dodge
feat=feat:weapon_focus
feat=feat:toughness
feat=feat:cleave
feat=feat:combat_reflexes
feat=feat:improved_critical
skill=skill:climb:1
skill=skill:intimidate:1
skill=skill:swim:1
equipment=item:chain_shirt:equipped_worn_active
equipment=item:longsword:equipped_primary_active
equipment=item:shield:absent
equipment=power_attack:selected_inactive
choice=choice:level_1_character_feat:feat:power_attack
choice=choice:human_bonus_feat:feat:dodge
choice=choice:fighter_bonus_feat:feat:weapon_focus:weapon:longsword
choice=choice:fighter_bonus_feat_2:feat:toughness
choice=choice:fighter_bonus_feat_4:feat:cleave
choice=choice:fighter_weapon_training_group:group:heavy_blades
